title: Cousins in Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree with unique node values, determine if two specified nodes, x and y, are cousins.
statement: Given a binary tree with unique node values, determine if two specified nodes, x and y, are cousins. Nodes are cousins if they share the same depth but have different parents. The root is at depth 0, and children are one level deeper.
constraints: Tree values are unique and x,y exist.
Return whether x and y have the same depth but different parents.
